'''Anaxes''' was a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the [[Axum system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Known as the "Defender of the Core", for millennia it was the site of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] primary fleet base and [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|War College]]. It was considered the site of [[Navy/Legends|naval]] power, tradition and prestige by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Anaxes shared its sun, [[Solis Axum]], with [[Selgon]], [[Grastes]], [[Axum]], [[Urfon]], [[Phlors Rex]], [[Phlors Regina]], and [[Ichium]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===The Azure Imperium===
Discovered by early space-faring [[Human/Legends|Humans]] before the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], colonists from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] settled the world after arriving in the Axum system on [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]]. For tens of thousands of years the Anaxsi inhabited the world, and Anaxes became the chief [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] and [[fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Azure Imperium]], which ruled the surrounding systems from Anaxes' sister world [[Axum]].<ref name="TEA" />

Anaxes was one of the Core planets that benefited during the expansion and the colonization wave towards [[the Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

===The Defender of the Core===
In [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], Anaxes and Axum were among the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the Azure Imperium peacefully assimilated into the new government. Anaxes continued to serve as the Republic's primary fleet base and shipyard, guarding the approach to Coruscant along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. As a testament to its tradition, it was home to the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Republic Navy War College]], the primary naval strategy facility in the galaxy, housed in the massive [[Anaxes Citadel]], which was established with Republic funding to consecrate the power and prestige of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] erupted with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|invasion of Coruscant]] under the command of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. Rallying at Anaxes, the Republic Navy counterattacked and drove the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from Coruscant. 

Following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] and the dismantling of much of the Republic's armed forces, the Naval College was largely moribund, but was reestablished as the College of Planetary Security Forces to train officers for [[Planetary Security Forces|local defense forces]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic|Republic's Golden Age]], Anaxes produced many notable [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] and navy personnel. Amongst them were Admiral [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], the [[Holt family]], and crime lord [[Tyber Zann]] who was born in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]. The [[Holt Cross]] was bestowed upon the world's naval base, one of the highest certificates of honor a world could receive.<ref name="CCW" />

===The Rise of the Empire===
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Anaxes became a prominent installation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the fight against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Anaxes was the headquarters of the Republic's [[First Army]], defending the Core against Separatist incursions, In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]] was fought between the Galactic Republic's [[Victory Fleet]], led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and Captain [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]], and the Separatist [[Bulwark Fleet]], led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo]]. The Republic was eventually victorious after killing the CIS Commander and utterly destroying the fleet. A pivotal battle in the war, the outcome decided who would control the Core Worlds and as such, the victors were hailed as heroes.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
[[File:Anaxes.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Imperial parade in [[Pols Anaxes]].]]
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] rose to power in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], many career officers from "[[Generationals|Generational]]" families were cast aside for devotees of the Empire. However, they also made sure the wellsprings of the Navy's tradition continued. Anaxes soon became the command center for the [[Imperial Center Oversector]], a move by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to smooth over any misgivings the world's populace might have towards his ascension to power and restructuring of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Upon the creation of [[First Army|Azure Hammer Command]], whose [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Whelm]]'' and fifty-seven other capital ships defended [[Imperial Center Oversector|Sector Zero]], Anaxes was chosen as its command base. A separate command called [[Azure Shield]] was created to protect the [[Azure sector/Legends|Azure sector]] and its neighbors. Azure Hammer Command was led by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]] until the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CCW" /><ref name="TEA" />

===The Galactic Civil War and beyond===
[[File:Anaxesbattle.jpg|thumb|Rebel [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|T2-B tanks]] raiding Anaxes.]]
Azure Hammer Command, Anaxes Citadel, and all forces in Sector Zero were constantly changed hands as warlords attempted to take the throne after Palpatine's death at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. While Admiral [[Osted Wermis]] held out for nearly five years, the death of Warlord [[Zsinj]] pushed Wermis towards signing a treaty with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Wermis' hand was forced when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Feyet Kiez]] absconded from the Axum system in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] with the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]'', having been summoned by the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to his growing empire in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. The linchpin of his defense gone, Wermis surrendered Anaxes to the New Republic shortly afterwards.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref><ref name="TEA" />

A sign of stability and comfort to New Republic citizens, the world held out through the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], though its involvement was unremarkable. After the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] agreed to defend the [[Fel Empire]] should another threat arise during the [[Treaty of Anaxes]] in [[127 ABY]], the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] betrayed the Alliance to the [[One Sith]] and [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] broke out again, seeing the destruction of the Alliance and [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Geography==
[[File:AnaxesSpace.jpg|thumb|left|Anaxes from space.]]
While not as industrialized as [[Axum]], Anaxes was more prestigious, home to many families associated with a tradition of service in the Fleet. It was home to [[Azure Motorworks]], a major producer of luxury vehicles. Considered an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], in that it was a planet-wide city, it was more reminiscent of a [[Green Coruscant]], though, in that it was sprinkled with beautiful parks and green areas in and around the city like the [[Great Plain of Anaxes]].<ref name="EAWGG" /> Anaxes' industrial output was considered impressive relative to other systems, but it was much smaller than neighboring Axum's.<ref name="TEA" />

Anaxes was also home to [[Keffi/Legends|Keffis]], which the resident [[Anaxsi]] bred for not only riding, but prestige. They were often used in areas deemed off-limits to most vehicles by the Anaxsi, such as the [[Pols Anaxes|capital]].<ref name="EAWGG" />

The primary icon of power for not only Anaxes, but the [[Azure Imperium]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], was [[Anaxes Citadel]], a massive complex of training schools, research labs, intelligence centers, offices, archives, and parade grounds that also served as the main governmental building on the planet. The terraced [[Sirpar Hills]] above the Citadel were dotted with estates held by families that may have not been Old Anaxsi, but whose names were synonymous with naval service. [[Sirpar Station]] was the dividing guard post between the Hills and the Citadel.<ref name="EAWGG" />

The planet also gave its name to [[Anaxes Station]], a space station near the planet, on the fringes of the Axum system.<ref name="EAWGG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Anakin's involved on/off throughout the arc but it's mostly Rex in charge of The Batch. Takes place on Anaxes & Skako Minor.|Brent Friedman, on the unproduced ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' arc featuring "The Bad Batch"|<ref name="Friedman Twitter S7 Story">{{Twitter|BFree63|status/468538272734797824|[[Brent Friedman]]|quote=Anakin's involved on/off throughout the arc but it's mostly Rex in charge of The Batch. Takes place on Anaxes & Skako Minor.}}</ref>}}
[[File:Anaxes_space.jpg|thumb|Anaxes in Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]
Anaxes was created by author [[Jason Fry]] for the [[2003]] book ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', remarking that he "thought it would be cool to have a place where you could set a space version of [[Wikipedia:An Officer and a Gentleman|''An Officer and a Gentleman'']]." Anaxes' history and role in the Republic and Empire, especially in periods when the Republic lacked a standing military, was subsequently expanded in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', both co-authored by Fry.<ref name="Blog-danwallace|145">{{Blog|danwallace|145|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 3 of 5)}}</ref>

In [[May]] [[2014]], [[Brent Friedman]], a writer for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, revealed that Anaxes would have been featured in a four-episode story arc that he wrote. The arc, though initially unproduced, would have focused on a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit called The Bad Batch.<ref name="Friedman Twitter S7 Story" /> Jason Fry admitted he was disappointed that the planet he created seemingly didn't make it into the series,<ref name="Fry on TFN">{{JCFCite|url=posts/51541200|board=Literature|thread=The Official Jason Fry Discussion Thread|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2014-05-20|time=1:30 PM}}</ref> but his luck would end up changing for the better, as the arc was eventually completed and aired [[February 21]], [[2020]] on [[Disney+]] after the series was revived [[2018|two years earlier]].<ref name="Press Release">{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/new-on-disney-plus-february-2020|text=What's New on Disney Plus February 2020, Including Toy Story 4|author=Gregory Lawrance|archivedate=20200221195811}}</ref>
